notes: MiniMax-H3's height 400 lists [480, 540, 768, 1080, 1440] and MiniMax-H3-Turbo's (resolved id MiniMax-H3-MultiMax) lists [480, 540, 768, 1080], on T2V, I2V and R2V alike. The 2026-10-25 400s did not list 540 (machgen-grids-2026-10-25.json).

540 is a private height, as 1080 is: this account's model list omits it, a 540p request from this account answers 403 'not available for your account' on both models, and the public pricebook has no 540p row for either. The grids keep both because MachGen's height 400 lists them, the precedent of machgen-turbo-durations-2026-11-11.json.
A 540p request with duration_secs 999 answered 403, not the duration 400, so the access check runs before the duration check, as it did for 1080p on 2026-10-25.
Durations and aspect ratios are unchanged: 1-30 s for MiniMax-H3 (2026-10-25) and 1-15 s for MiniMax-H3-Turbo (2026-11-11).
MiniMax-H3-Omni answered 403 'not available for your account' before any grid check, so the probes say nothing about its heights.
